latest_user_change: Every new candidate tests source seen receivers, cross-receiver clean, and cross-receiver satellite; all three use frozen DURA v1.0 before PAMF. Preserve class-macro A_K/R_U/H and condition-specific targets, C_K>=90%, same-input same-DURA-path original F0 closed minus A_K<=2pp.

post_phase1_input_policy.clean_cross_receiver_scope: Mandatory frozen test comparator through DURA; no clean training/adaptation/discovery/registration/query fitting. Its original F0 baseline consumes the same DURA(clean) output.
post_phase1_input_policy.P1: same satellite received through frozen DURA v1.0

default_evaluation_matrix.source_seen_receiver_input: existing fixed satellite source observations through DURA
default_evaluation_matrix.practical_cross_receiver_input: fixed satellite public observations through DURA
default_evaluation_matrix.closed_baseline: original F0 on exactly the same DURA output as each candidate
default_evaluation_matrix.threshold_sharing: preregister source-only calibration and sharing policy before any target query access

known_macro_acceptance.objective: maximize subject to unknown rejection and known identity protection
known_macro_acceptance.definition: 1 minus known macro false rejection rate; wrong accepted identity is reported separately

primary_report.averaging: First calculate within each required true TX, then weight TX equally; known and unknown rosters are separate
primary_report.A_K: known_macro_open_accuracy: correct identity AND accepted, divided by all known observations within each TX
primary_report.R_U: unknown_macro_rejection: rejected observations divided by all unknown observations within each TX
primary_report.H-score: 2*A_K*R_U/(A_K+R_U), using macro A_K and macro R_U; zero when either measured component is zero, null when required coverage is missing
accompanying_constraints: R_U>=0.90 for the satellite primary condition
R_U>=0.95 for the clean comparator through DURA
primary_report.drop_unit: absolute proportion difference; 0.02 equals 2 percentage points, not a 2% relative reduction

threshold_selection: source only; no target truth, true class count, quota or query-score calibration
historical_results: Keep original preregistered criteria and verdicts; do not relabel old runs as passed
